_readme: Character status effects. 'stat_mods' are applied to that character's effective stats during every check. 'duration' counts rooms; -1 means it lasts until healed or cleared. A character at 0 health becomes 'unconscious' - they are unavailable for checks but the run continues.

statuses.name: Scared
statuses.blurb: Quieter than usual, for the worst reason.

statuses.name: Suspected
statuses.blurb: On a list. A short one.

statuses.name: Unconscious
statuses.blurb: Unavailable for selection. Still technically on the crew.
